howto.name: Upload a PDF
howto.text: Drop a PDF up to 500 MB.

howto.name: Choose DPI
howto.text: Higher DPI = sharper TIFF. 300 DPI is standard for archival; 600 for high-resolution professional output.

howto.name: Download the TIFF
howto.text: PrivaTools produces a single multi-page TIFF (one image per PDF page) or a ZIP of individual TIFFs.

faq.a: TIFF supports lossless compression (LZW, Deflate) and is the format of choice for long-term preservation in libraries and government archives.

faq.q: Single multi-page TIFF or one per page?
faq.a: Default is multi-page TIFF for compact archiving. Use the per-page option for compatibility with software that only reads single-page TIFFs.
TIFF is raster only — the text layer is lost. Use Sanitize PDF or PDF/A for archive while keeping text searchable.
